verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents injecting dynamic variables or per-caller context into an agent's conversation at call time. Contact properties are mentioned only for choosing SMS/WhatsApp recipients, and the related items describe adjacent features rather than this capability: custom tools fetch external data mid-call, and the schedule-call API covers timing and dialing windows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inject dynamic variables and per-caller context at call time so each conversation is personalized
